column1: # Ledger for b13-dashboard-screen: one row per original Java expression whose literals left src/.

column5: the constant becomes a CharSequence holding the deferred M.dashboardWidgetLimit(), rendered where each use shows it (R5: no rendered text in a static field)

column2: ["about ", {"hole": "(units.equals(\"km\") ? km : units.equals(\"dual\") ? miles + \" / \" + km : miles)", "arg": 1, "type": "s", "as": "(units.equals(\"km\") ? km : units.equals(\"dual\") ? T.fmtDual(miles, km) : miles)"}]
column5: manual: the hole is the same choice of distances, with its dual form miles + " / " + km now T.fmtDual(miles, km) (the next row), whose English is the same

Telemetry's English marker of a signed reading stays data: moved into the constant TELEMETRY_SIGNED, which label() and englishLabel() test and strip on Telemetry's English label (never on shown text); a signed reading shows its ScooterReadingLabels short name ("Battery current", "Battery power": the base's stripped label), any other its full name
the optional hours part becomes two whole templates, with hours and without

whole block: the two-argument InfoCell constructor, which picked the narrow label by comparing the title with the English "Charging power" (R3: never compare shown text), is gone; InfoTiles.add(icon, title) builds every cell with its one title, and both charging power cells then set their narrow label with InfoCell.narrowLabel(T.dashboardChargingPower(), T.dashboardChargingPowerCompact()) on a line of its own
whole block: the narrow label "Power" moved to dashboard_charging_power_compact, which both charging power cells set with InfoCell.narrowLabel right after they are made

manual: a plural, so a language can inflect "percent" by the number; number was Long.toString(Math.round(level)), so the call passes Math.round(level) as the quantity and the number (English says "percent" for every number)
the chip and the explanation, each optional, become four whole templates; estimate.status is ChargingEstimate's English diagnostic (B5 left it English)

column2: {"if": "Double.isNaN(level)", "then": {"if": "hasLimit", "then": ["Charge not reported", ", charge limit ", {"hole": "Math.round(limit)", "arg": 1, "type": "s", "as": "Fmt.integer(Math.round(limit))"}, " percent"], "else": ["Charge not reported", ""]}, "else": {"if": "hasLimit", "then": ["Charge ", {"hole": "Math.round(level)", "arg": 1, "type": "s", "as": "Fmt.integer(Math.round(level))"}, " percent", ", charge limit ", {"hole": "Math.round(limit)", "arg": 2, "type": "s", "as": "Fmt.integer(Math.round(limit))"}, " percent"], "else": ["Charge ", {"hole": "Math.round(level)", "arg": 1, "type": "s", "as": "Fmt.integer(Math.round(level))"}, " percent", ""]}}
column5: the level (or not reported) and the optional charge limit become four whole sentences

manual: etaLabels[0] + (tag shown ? " (" + tag + ")" : "") became tag shown ? T.dashboardChargingTimeTag(etaLabels[0], tag) : etaLabels[0]; without the chip the name is passed as it is (no text of its own)
the optional detail becomes two whole templates
